title: Rapid Mental Calculations Failure
summary: This note details an instance where the owner bypassed the standard operating procedure for verifying elevator weight due to rapid mental calculations when a demanding client requested heavy wood panels and Italian marble flooring. This action led to switching the marble flooring for thin set tiles, resulting in financial losses for Otis and project delays.

key_points.text: Release elevator into fabrication after rapid mental calculations
Did not follow the SOP of verifying the weight first
Had to switch out marble flooring for thin set tiles
Otis incurred financial losses, and project delays
Created a pre-fabrication checklist that lists the most common pitfalls
